scripts.typecheck: quint typecheck model.qnt && quint typecheck repos.qnt && quint typecheck scenarios.qnt && quint typecheck witnesses.qnt && quint typecheck properties.qnt
scripts.quint:test: quint test --main scenarios --match 'Run$' --max-samples=1 scenarios.qnt && quint test --main witnesses --match 'Witness$' --max-samples=1 witnesses.qnt
scripts.quint:properties: quint run properties.qnt --main properties --init start --step step --max-samples 150 --max-steps 1 --invariant allHold
